Name: Joja Cola Restock
Author: Lycanglass
Description:
[b][i][b][i]2.0 UPDATE! Support for all Stardew Valley Languages*, 3 new drinks, Joja Cola AMPED now an energy drink (different people like it now), and some sprite updates![/i][/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/URyqHnX.png[/img][/i][/b]

[size=1]*Via edited Google Translate; if you'd like to translate this mod, let me know, and we'll work to update any inaccuracies![/size]

[size=2]This mod, Joja Co﻿la Restock, adds [/size][b]14[/b][size=2] lore-friendly sodas/colas to the Joja Mart, and revamps the vending machine at the Stardrop Saloon to offer most of them! Two sodas (Kyurei and New Joja) are only available at Sandy's for ~reasons~. Everyone has likes and dislikes for these drinks, and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753?tab=files]SVE[/url][size=2]﻿ NPCs are supported. This mod shouldn't conflict with anything unless it changes the vending machine in the Saloon. Most of the sodas don't give boosts, but Cafe Joja, Joja Cola AMPED, JojAid, and New Joja give very small, temporary ones. To install, just extract, drag and drop the contents into your mods folder.[/size]

In order to use this mod, you will need:
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url][/b]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4661]JsonAssets[/url]
[/b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1820]TMXL Map Toolkit[/url]
[b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5005]Shop Tile Framework[/url][/b][/b]

Now, onto more details/the more in-world sales pitch! :P

---

[font=Georgia][color=#89b6ff][size=5]WELCOME TO THE RURAL ROLLOUT™[/size][size=5]![/size][/color][/font]
[color=#00c9ff][b]
[font=Georgia]Introduction[/font][/b][/color]
People around the world have heard of our refreshing, and delicious, Joja[size=1]®[/size] Cola. It's our flagship brand, and the one that gave us the start we needed in order to grow into a company that could offer valued customers virtually everything they need.

But Joja[size=1]®[/size] Cola isn't the only soda we have here at Joja[size=1]®[/size] Corporation. No, not by a long shot!

Our company has spent years researching and developing different sodas and colas, and recently, we have begun to ensure people have access to our core catalogue no matter where they are. So we'd like to welcome you, [u][i]STARDEW VALLEY[/i][/u] , to our Rural Rollout™ program!

[font=Georgia][color=#00c9ff][b]What is the Rural Rollout™?[/b][/color][/font][b]
[/b]The Rural Rollout™ ensures that your rural town/village/settlement has access to a variety of Joja[size=1]®[/size] beverages we've deemed suitable for local tastes using advanced demographic research (pending patents). Below you'll find a list of allocated beverages, and the local stockists that sell them!

[color=#00c9ff][b][font=Georgia]Regarding Unauthorised Stockists[/font]
[/b][/color]It has come to our attention that some have taken it upon themselves to distribute Joja[size=1]®[/size] products outside the official community chain. This is not only harmful to Joja's financial interests, but the community itself: Discontinued, or unapproved foreign imports, come with risks that the Joja[size=1]®[/size] Corporation cannot guarantee against. We advise anyone who comes across such a dealer to contact us immediately.

Thank you for your time in reading this form. We are happy to welcome everyone in [u][i]STARDEW VALLEY[/i][/u] to our Rural Rollout™! If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us through your local Joja Representative.
